component.name: OmaTree
component.summary: A local-first notebook for people who think in trees

description.p: OmaTree is a deliberately simple note-taking application: a tree of notes on the left and the selected note on the right. Every note can have child notes, so ideas branch the way your thinking does.
Notes are plain text that you can switch to a read-only Markdown preview. A notebook is a single local .omatree file on your computer. There is no account and no cloud service.
